content:
GOAL: design one in-scope mechanism for the third behaviour-graph-curvature exploration, satisfying (a) additive top-1-provable behaviour bias, (b) exact-multiset resolution protection by construction, (c) curvature spent but not as a radius scale, (d) train-split-only offline standardised curvature, (e) three switches.
READ: round-1 failure (kappa spent on radius, codebook 170->56 triples, recall 0.041888); round-2 failure (multiplicative per-pair weight moved margins but zero argmins moved); round-2 partial capacity freeze (Sinkhorn plan argmax need not reproduce marginals); baseline TIGER_RQ-VAE 247/7414/20223 prefixes, test_recall@10 0.055537, kappa_hat=[-2.32,-1.80,-0.86], delta=[-0.328,-0.071,+0.399]; budget 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs (=72000 steps), 4 cards.
REASONING: (b) is solved exactly by making the assignment a PERMUTATION of the Euclidean nearest-neighbour assignment: a transposition sequence preserves the usage multiset identically (not a plan whose argmax may miss the marginals), and it makes the collision rate invariant by construction, which is precisely what round 1 destroyed. (a) is solved by an ADDITIVE z-free bias term in the same cost, so switching it off provably changes argmins (measured as a per-level swap/flip rate, which is exactly 0 only when both bias and metric perturbation are off). (c) is solved by never touching radius/normalisation: kappa_hat enters only as an additive per-pair cost term, and the multiset invariance means neither the hyperbolic metric nor the curvature can shrink the codebook. (d) is solved by a standalone CPU artifact (curvature on the frozen baseline's train-split prefixes, null-standardised by size-preserving member shuffle) memory-mapped by every rank; and because the assignment is per-local-shard, the union of the 4 ranks' Euclidean multisets is STILL exactly the global batch Euclidean multiset, so no collective is needed in the assignment path at all.
CHOSEN COUPLING: cost C[i,k] = d_P(x_i,e_k)/m_l + eta_l * clip(kappa_hat_l(a0_i,k),-4,4) * w_i(k)/w_i, minimised over permutations with the Euclidean nearest multiset q by a vectorised 2-swap descent; curved metric Poincare c=1, curved codebook update via tangent-space barycentre.
STILL OPEN: nothing blocking; the final answer is written as the next record.

FINAL ANSWER (condensed record; full block printed in the response): IDEA CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID -- curvature-biased, quota-exact 2-swap code assignment for a Poincare-ball RQ-VAE.
MECHANISM: assignment is restricted to a PERMUTATION of the Euclidean nearest-neighbour assignment of the local batch shard, so the per-level usage multiset is invariant BY CONSTRUCTION (transpositions cannot change counts; collision rate and exposure identical; round-1's 170->56 collapse is structurally impossible). Inside each level, cost C[i,k] = d_P(x_i,e_k)/m_l + eta_l*clip(kappa_hat_l(a0_i,k),-4,4)*(w_i(k)/w_i); minimised by up to 12 exact 2-swaps from a0, vectorised as M[i,k]=C[i,k]-C[i,a[i]], A[p,r]=scatter-min, G=A+A^T, swap while min G<0. Curved side: Poincare c=1 fixed, phi(z)=z/(1+||z||), codebook EMA in the tangent space at the origin.
ARTIFACT: offline CPU, train split only -- directed transition counts, quotient graph on the frozen baseline's train prefixes, Ollivier alpha=0.5 curvature, null-standardised by 32 size-preserving member shuffles on 2000 sampled edges per level, clipped at 4 sigma, eta_l = delta_l/std(delta) (~[-1.09,-0.24,+1.33] from [-2.32,-1.80,-0.86]); acceptance check |kappa_bar - recorded| <= 0.15. Memory-mapped by all ranks; no collective in the assignment path, and because each rank shards the batch the union of the four local Euclidean multisets is still exactly the global one.
SWITCHES: behaviour off = eta_l <- 0 (bias identically zero); geometry off = Euclidean norm plus plain-mean codebook; both on = trained arm. Off-arms exercised only in no-grad inference passes, never trained.
COST: ~3-6 ms per step (786k Poincare distances + 12MFLOP swaps + 3 host syncs), 5-10% over baseline, ~6 min over 72000 steps; artifact 25-45 min once, 20-30 MB.
OPEN: nothing blocking; hypothesis falsifiable at the assignment by a swap rate below ~1% at every level.
